decision: Use YOLOE for three_wheeler, then review and de-duplicate against YOLO26.

params: --model yolo26 --size m --classes person,motorbike,car --images img_004.jpg img_013.jpg --conf 0.3 --segmenter sam --sam sam2.1_b.pt --device cuda

what_went_wrong: Mask quality depends on the input box; an incorrect or loose box can produce an incorrect mask and needs visual checking.
decision: Use SAM 2.1 for objects requiring masks; it does not replace review.
